main_body: A snow-covered wooden market-stall/crate: snow cap on top, a dark frame with a tan plank shelf/slats on the front, and a dark base strip.
top_band: Snow cap in white/pale blue-grey at about rows 1-8, with a bumpy lower edge and icicles at rows 9-10. It reads as a snow roof; the rows are mostly a front-facing white mass rather than a clear horizontal surface set above a separate front face.
evidence: The snow cap is a pale mass on top, but it blends into a front-facing snow fringe with icicles and has no distinct front-edge line separating the top from the face. Below it the body is a flat front view of slats and a dark frame, and the inset shadow only suggests depth on the front. The overall read is a front elevation with a hat. The object is also labelled organic (snow), yet it is drawn as a stall or crate, so the kind does not fit.

style.evidence: The candidate matches the roofed-stall reference in structure. Snow has about 4 lightness steps (white, pale blue, light grey-blue, mid blue-grey), and the tan planks have 2-3 tones. The dark frame is a tinted grey-brown, not pure black. However, the tan plank blocks are fairly flat, and the dark grey side panels and bottom strip are large flat areas with little grain. Density is lower than the reference stall, which carries more detail and per-tile variation.
